The correct emission factors to be used are: Electricity (0.000293071 MWh/kbtu, 552.8 lb CO2e/MWh), Gas (0.001 MMBtu/kbtu, 53.11 kg CO2e/MMBtu), and Oil (0.001 MMBtu/kbtu, 74.21 kg CO2e/MMBtu). Conversion constants: 2204.62 lb/MT and 1000 kg/MT. The final file must be an .xlsx file at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/ghg_inventory_2023.xlsx with two specific sheets: 'Emissions_Data' and 'ESG_Summary'.
